prompts.night: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished 4K landscape 16:9 desktop wallpaper for MoOS, a modern KDE Plasma desktop with Liquid Glass visual identity. Create an original premium sculptural scene called MoOS Prism Night. An elegant sweeping folded ribbon of smoked optical glass and satin titanium, flowing in a broad graceful arc across the lower middle of a deep graphite and midnight teal space. Subtle refracted cyan light at the bevels, a restrained violet glint, physically convincing translucency, fine polished surfaces. Architectural precision and cinematic studio lighting, exceptionally clean gradients. Leave the upper half and outer edges quiet for desktop widgets and readable icons; a soft low horizon and darker bottom edge for a translucent dock. The visual should feel bold, sophisticated and calm, not a stock wavy gradient or gaming neon. Full bleed, 3840x2160 composition. No text, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, UI, frames, watermarks, stars, particles or objects from other operating system identities.
prompts.dawn: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: finished landscape 16:9 desktop wallpaper for MoOS called Prism Dawn, the light counterpart to the attached Prism Night wallpaper. Keep the same sculptural flowing glass-and-titanium ribbon, broad arc composition, graceful architectural curves and clean upper-half negative space. Transform the lighting and materials into a luminous pearl-white and misty sea-glass environment: pale cool silver metal, clear aquamarine optical glass, restrained soft teal reflections, warm ivory rim light. High-end architectural studio photograph, exceptionally smooth polished surfaces and quiet gradients, balanced luminous midtones without blown white highlights. A subtle horizon and bottom edge with enough depth for a translucent desktop dock. Full-bleed 3840x2160 composition, crisp clean 4K desktop art. Do not add any text, marks, logos, symbols, UI, stars, particles or frames. Preserve this original MoOS composition rather than imitating any other OS wallpaper.

policy: Original generated pixels; no logos or third-party artwork. Requested 4K composition does not imply the tool delivered 4K resolution.
